A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and contain 39 pages, including Appendices A–J and the checklist. Full text comparison and rendered-page checks establish that the text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original training and fine-tuning results on CIFAR-10/100, ImageNet-1K, and GLUE in Section 5, alongside diagnostic experiments and additional accuracy and timing results in Appendix J.

after.justification: v3 retains original benchmark results in Tables 1–3, robustness and diagnostic measurements in Figures 1–2 and Tables 4–6, and additional experimental results in Appendix J.

M1.justification: The SAM/USAM procedures and RW-SAM method are unchanged. Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same reweighting objective, gradient-norm estimator, normalization, perturbation calculation, and parameter update.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same CIFAR-10/100, ImageNet-1K, and GLUE coverage, including training from scratch, fine-tuning, noisy-label evaluation, and poor-minimum escape experiments. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments: SGD/SAM in the main vision benchmarks, AdamW/SAM on GLUE, the SAM/USAM variants in Table 7, and ASAM in Table 9.

E3.justification: Sections 3.5 and 5 and Appendix J retain the same model configurations, batch sizes, training budgets, augmentation, learning-rate schedules, evaluation measures, and hyperparameter searches. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The poor-minimum escape and SGN-variance analysis in Figures 1–2, label-noise tests in Table 4, lambda sensitivity in Table 5, covariance measurements in Table 6, and ASAM extension experiment in Table 9 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report three independent experiments and mean plus standard deviation for Tables 1 and 2a. The remaining uncertainty reporting and checklist statements are also unchanged; no run counts, seeds, or statistical procedures are added.

E6.justification: Figures 1–2 and Tables 1–9 retain their result entries, numerical values, and trends. For example, Table 2a reports ImageNet-1K accuracy of 77.16±0.04 for SAM and 77.37±0.05 for RW-SAM in both versions. Appendix J's accuracy and timing results also match.

T1.justification: The definitions, assumptions, SDEs, propositions, and appendix proofs retain their mathematical content. Theorem C.2(i) only receives a parenthesis-sizing correction; its expression and Lipschitz assumption are unchanged.

C1.justification: The revised abstract and contribution bullets foreground the extended SDE framework and stronger regularization at smaller m, both already presented in v2. The scientific scope, RW-SAM generalization claim, and conclusion remain unchanged.

C2.justification: The smaller-m mechanism stated more explicitly in v3's opening already appears in v2 Sections 3.3–3.5. Interpretations concerning SGN covariance, generalization, and computational overhead, together with the stated qualifications and limitations, are retained.

D1.justification: Implementation details, Algorithm 1, hyperparameters, Table 10's GLUE settings, RTX 4090 hardware disclosure, and timing information are unchanged. Both checklists continue to state that code is not yet available and is planned for release upon acceptance.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, and substantive positioning relative to prior SAM and SDE research are unchanged. Section 2 only receives a punctuation edit and page reflow; Appendix F is unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 shortens and rewrites the abstract and reorganizes the contribution bullets around the framework, mechanism, and algorithm. It also removes redundant affiliation superscripts and makes limited punctuation edits. The wider narrative and section order remain intact.

P2.justification: The revised opening reflows pages 1–3, moving the start of Section 2 from page 3 to page 2. The parenthesis correction in Theorem C.2 causes local reflow on page 24. Figures 1–2, Tables 1–10, and Algorithm 1 remain visually unchanged.

improvement.justification: The shorter abstract and reorganized contribution summary make the existing connection between smaller micro-batches and stronger variance regularization easier to identify. Together with the Theorem C.2 typesetting correction, this provides a modest improvement in exposition. The method, mathematical arguments, and empirical support remain unchanged.
